arguments.question: Across ANET, MU, META and NVDA, review the latest available company filings/primary materials for 21/63-session catalysts, reported operating trends, guidance or disclosed demand/supply constraints, and key company-specific risks. For QQQ, use the dated sponsor profile/holdings to identify material look-through concentration only. Do not estimate consensus or target prices. Stop after the latest material filing/primary item per company plus the QQQ profile/holdings; state evidence gaps.
arguments.decision_impact: Could differentiate company and ETF theses and determine whether company-specific evidence supports an assessment versus insufficient evidence.
